editorial:
You know that feeling when your friends all have plans and you're left wondering what to do with your weekend? That's basically where Boog finds himself at the start of this third adventure. His forest buddies are busy with family stuff, so the big grizzly decides to head out on his own and stumbles straight into a circus. There he meets a sneaky look-alike bear named Doug who tricks him into swapping places. Suddenly Boog is performing under the big top, falling for a charming Russian circus bear, and learning that maybe family and friendship aren't so different after all. The whole thing has a warm, silly energy that keeps kids giggling and parents smiling.

The animation is bright and colorful, and the circus setting gives the story a fresh backdrop compared to the earlier films. The voice cast brings plenty of personality, especially the gruff but lovable Boog and the smooth-talking Doug. Sure, the plot is pretty predictable and some jokes feel familiar, but the heart is in the right place. If you're looking for a cozy family movie night pick, this one delivers. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Boog realizes Doug has been using him all along and that the circus life isn't really where he belongs. After a big showdown under the big top, Boog's forest friends show up to help him. Doug gets his comeuppance and is sent away, while Boog returns to the woods with a new appreciation for his family. The movie ends with everyone back together, proving that you don't have to choose between your old friends and new ones.
targetAudience: Ideal for families with young kids and fans of animated animal adventures.
